title: XIANG
summary: 中国象棋 · 三档开源 AI 与六位码联机 / Chinese chess with AI and LAN play
description:
在 Cardputer Zero 下中国象棋。支持三档离线人机、同机双人和局域网联机。局域网对局使用 6 位数字房间码，网页与 Zero 可以互相建房和加入。配对需要联网，走棋通过 WebRTC 直连。简体中文和英文界面可切换，按 Esc 或 Backspace 取消选棋。

Play Chinese chess on Cardputer Zero against the offline engine, with a friend on one device, or over LAN. Pair over the internet with a six-digit code, then play directly over WebRTC. Supports Simplified Chinese and English.

联机网页 / Web app: https://xiangzero.vercel.app/
源码 / Source: https://github.com/xu-c/XIANG
